<!-- Tip: If the app fails to start or behaves unexpectedly, running with
--verbose prints system diagnostics that help identify the problem:

  UsageMonitorForClaudeAndCodex.exe --verbose

or from source:

  python -m usage_monitor --verbose

The rotating application log is beside the EXE (or in the project root
when running from source). To capture verbose diagnostics as well, use:

  cmd /c "UsageMonitorForClaudeAndCodex.exe --verbose > log.txt 2>&1"

This command also works from PowerShell. Quit from either tray menu to
finish collecting output. Review the log before sharing it.

Paste the output below if you can - it saves a lot of back and forth. -->
